summary: Plan as of Nov 19: 3 full days in Ho Chi Minh City, flying from RDU, upscale District 1 hotel $160–$250+/night; nothing booked. Matt is now considering moving the trip from December 2026 to February 2027. Key factor found: Tet (Lunar New Year) falls Sat Feb 6, 2027, official break Feb 4–10, when many local restaurants/shops close, Saigon empties out, and flights/hotels cost more. February weather is similar to December (dry season), slightly hotter and drier.
open_questions: Whether to keep December 2026 or move to February 2027.
If February: whether to avoid Tet (Feb 4–10, 2027) or deliberately experience it; Feb 12+ suggested as safer if avoiding.
Final dates not selected; no bookings made.
